scripts.dev: npm run build -w @vr/instrument && concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,yellow "npm run dev -w core-service-api" "npm run dev -w web-app"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @vr/instrument && npm run build -w core-service-api && npm run build -w web-app
scripts.test: npm run test -w @vr/instrument && npm run test -w core-service-api
